No desktop client to install."},{"id":"p2s1","text":"# @uumit-ai/dsh-uumit-remote"},{"id":"p3s1","text":"English | 简体中文"},{"id":"p4s1","text":"A DeepSeek Harness (DSH) plugin that lets you open the DSH running on your computer from your phone "},{"id":"p4s2","text":"or any other computer, through UUMit. You, and t"},{"id":"p5s3","text":"he people you invite, then open the app URL (like `https://dsh--<your-computer>.<UUMit address domai"},{"id":"p5s4","text":"n>/`) and get the same DSH as on your computer: chats, terminal, files and settings all work, and se"},{"id":"p5s5","text":"ttings are saved back to this computer."},{"id":"p6s1","text":"The plugin runs inside the DSH process and connects to the UUMit tunnel directly. It does not downlo"},{"id":"p6s2","text":"ad or start any other program, and it does not open any port on your computer."},{"id":"p7s1","text":"> **Beta.** This is a preview release, published under the `beta` tag. The button and "},{"id":"p7s3","text":"option names below are translated, with the Chinese label in parentheses."},{"id":"p8s1","text":"## Requirements"},{"id":"p9s1","text":"- `dsh web`, DeepSeek Harness 0.2.1-rc.2 or later. The DSH desktop app does not run a web server and"},{"id":"p9s2","text":" is not supported.
- Node.js 22.19 or later (the same as DSH).
- A UUMit account."},{"id":"p10s1","text":"## Install"},{"id":"p11s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p12s1","text":"Then restart `dsh web`."},{"id":"p13s1","text":"DSH installs plugins with pnpm, which by default skips releases published in the last 24 hours. With"},{"id":"p13s2","text":"in a day of a new release, `@beta` can still give you the previous version; to get the new one right"},{"id":"p13s3","text":" away, name the exact version, for example `@uumit-ai/dsh-uumit-remote@0.1.0-beta.3`."},{"id":"p14s1","text":"If you use a registry mirror such as npmmirror and the install reports that no matching version was "},{"id":"p14s2","text":"found, the mirror has not synced this release yet. Install straight from the official registry:"},{"id":"p15s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p16s1","text":"To uninstall:"},{"id":"p17s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p18s1","text":"The plugin is plain JavaScript with no runtime dependencies and no build step. The browser half (`cl"},{"id":"p18s2","text":"ient.js`) is written directly in the factory format the DSH module loader expects; React comes from "},{"id":"p18s3","text":"written directly in the factory format the DSH module loader expects; React comes from the DSH page."},{"id":"p19s1","text":"## Use"},{"id":"p20s1","text":"1. Open DSH on this computer and click **Remote access** (远程访问, a globe icon when the sidebar is col"},{"id":"p20s2","text":"lapsed) next to the settings button at the bottom of the sidebar. The panel opens inside the DSH pag"},{"id":"p20s3","text":"e, not in a new window. If the entry does not appear, open the fallback page at `<dsh web address>/u"},{"id":"p20s4","text":"umit-remote/`.
2. Click **Connect to UUMit** (连接到 UUMit), sign in to UUMit on the page that opens, c"},{"id":"p20s5","text":"heck that the connection code (连接码) matches the one in the panel, and confirm. If the confirmation p"},{"id":"p20s6","text":"age does not open, you can generate an 8-character pairing code on the UUMit website and enter it in"},{"id":"p20s7","text":"stead.
3. Once connected, DSH appears as the app `dsh` under your UUMit address. Under **Who can use"},{"id":"p20s8","text":" it** (谁能用), choose:
- **Only me** (仅自己): only you, signed in to UUMit;
- **Me and people I invite**"},{"id":"p20s9","text":" (我和我邀请的人): create invite links or grant access by phone number, and revoke at any time;
- **Everyon"},{"id":"p20s10","text":"e** (所有人): anyone with the URL can fully operate this DSH as you. The panel asks you to confirm;
- *"},{"id":"p20s11","text":"*Off** (关闭).
4. Open the **App URL** (应用网址) shown in the panel from anywhere.
5. When you no longer "},{"id":"p20s12","text":"need it, click **Disconnect this computer** (断开这台电脑). The computer is removed from your UUMit device"},{"id":"p20s13","text":"ed it, click **Disconnect this computer** (断开这台电脑). The computer is removed from your UUMit devices."},{"id":"p21s1","text":"The DSH agent can help too: the plugin registers the tool `uumit_remote_access` (show status, start "},{"id":"p21s2","text":"connecting, tell you where to manage it). The agent cannot change who can use the app."},{"id":"p22s1","text":"## Configuration"},{"id":"p23s1","text":"Override the entry with `id: uumit-remote` in the profile's `cordis.patch.yml`. The whole entry is r"},{"id":"p23s2","text":"eplaced, so omitted options go back to their defaults."},{"id":"p24s1","text":"| Option | Default | Description |"},{"id":"p25s1","text":"| `apiBase` | `https://api.uumit.com` | Platform endpoint. The `UUMIT_API_BASE` environment variable"},{"id":"p25s2","text":" takes precedence. Non-HTTPS is only allowed for loopback and private addresses |
| `serviceName` | "},{"id":"p25s3","text":"`dsh` | Name of the registered app |
| `deviceName` | `<hostname> · DSH` | Computer name shown on UU"},{"id":"p25s4","text":"Mit. Can also be set with `UUMIT_DEVICE_NAME` |
| `autoConnect` | `true` | Bring a connected compute"},{"id":"p25s5","text":"r online when DSH starts. Never starts pairing on its own |
| `home` | `$DSH_HOME/uumit-remote` | Lo"},{"id":"p25s6","text":"cal state directory |"},{"id":"p26s1","text":"Test-only switches: `UUMIT_TUNNEL_INSECURE_TLS=1` skips verification of the tunnel node certificate,"},{"id":"p26s2","text":" `UUMIT_TUNNEL_CA_FILE` sets a node CA file, and `UUMIT_WEB_BASE` sets the website base URL."},{"id":"p27s1","text":"## Security"},{"id":"p28s1","text":"- Access control is decided by the UUMit gateway; the plugin checks every request again with the sam"},{"id":"p28s2","text":"e rules and rejects anything missing or malformed.
- Remote browsers never receive DSH's own login c"},{"id":"p28s3","text":"redential. The plugin exchanges an internal credential locally, keeps it only in memory, and attache"},{"id":"p28s4","text":"s it to requests forwarded to DSH. After you revoke someone, their next request is rejected.
- The m"},{"id":"p28s5","text":"anagement panel only accepts the browser on this computer that already has DSH open. Remote pages op"},{"id":"p28s6","text":"ened through UUMit cannot reach it.
- The device credential is stored in `$DSH_HOME/uumit-remote/cre"},{"id":"p28s7","text":"dentials.json`, readable only by you, and never appears in logs or pages.
- Remote visitors pick fol"},{"id":"p28s8","text":"ders with an in-page browser, so no system dialog pops up on your screen. Features that open files o"},{"id":"p28s9","text":"r apps on this computer are hidden from remote visitors.
- **Everyone** means anonymous visitors can"},{"id":"p28s10","text":" use your terminal and files as you. Choose it only if you understand the risk."},{"id":"p29s1","text":"Please report security issues privately through GitHub's security advisory page rather than public i"},{"id":"p29s2","text":" report security issues privately through GitHub's security advisory page rather than public issues."},{"id":"p30s1","text":"## Development"},{"id":"p31s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p32s1","text":"`test:frps` needs an frps 0.71.0 binary, set with `FRPS_BIN` or placed at `test/e2e/.tools/frps`; wi"},{"id":"p32s2","text":"thout it those tests are skipped."},{"id":"p33s1","text":"[该节后续省略]"}],"truncated":true}
